entities.summary: Gerhardus "Gerard" Bernardus Josephus Westermann was a Dutch artist. In 1932 he won a bronze medal in the art competitions of the Olympic Games for his "Horseman". Westermann's work was included in the 1939 exhibition and sale Onze Kunst van Heden at the Rijksmuseum in Amsterdam, which holds over 60 of his works.
